about_the_game:
Long ago,

Ancient civilizations left behind the ruins of once-great cities.

In this dark world, filled with the echoes of the suffering of the last war,

you are one of the few people capable of fighting evil.

An incredible journey into a fairytale world awaits you

filled with enormous trees, cities, and villages.

Monsters called shadows, devouring life.

There are dialogues and battles, certainty versus doubt, and

The danger of extermination with moral dilemmas.

Oh, life, if only I could find a simple path

But there isn't one, should it be complicated, hero!?

The world is full of puzzles, if only I could defeat those hollow within,

those who are neither water nor fire!

Poisoned by dark forces with the poison of vice, but otherwise,

Like a jug empty? Are they not filled with goodness, not even a soul?

The dreams of simple people, as if from a folktale,

were mercilessly erased by the evil Dark King.

Having seen him, having lost the remnants of your soul, like an ignoramus, is it difficult to remain yourself?

Perhaps you can learn how to uncover the secret and defeat evil?

So, do you believe in yourself?

Are you ready to accept the fight, to know fear and endure pain?

At least press the button and receive a letter.

When the game comes out, you'll feel it for yourself.

Like in mirrors, good or evil looks...

At least 8 hours of gameplay awaits you. A deep storyline and a variety of mechanics, many unique locations and quests with moral choices. Engaging dialogues with characters and battles with powerful enemies. Puzzles and creation, a dark atmosphere and destruction, pleasing graphics and an interactive world.

Join this captivating journey where your destiny depends on your decisions, and every step brings you closer to unraveling the greatest mystery—the true nature of light and darkness. Will you be able to find balance between these forces and become the one who changes the world?

content_descriptors.notes:
Violence; Throughout the game, the player will kill enemy heroes, monsters, and possibly animals. At the scene of the murder, there will be corpses (rag doll) and a black liquid similar to blood until they disappear after a while. Whether to display this or not can be specified in the settings.
Nudity: a woman in a swimsuit or a man with a naked torso is the most you can see in this game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050Ti 4GB or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 32 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: In a World split by the confrontation between Light and Darkness, where Ancient Civilizations left behind Ruins of once great cities. You are a warrior of Light! The last ray of hope! The Future of this Magical World depends on you!
